## 📖 What needs improvement?

Which document or section? (e.g. README, CONTRIBUTING, code comment in `lib/instagram.ts`)

## 🔗 Link

Add a link or path to the affected documentation.

## ✍️ Proposed Change

Describe the improvement. Be specific — what should it say instead?

## 🎯 Why?

Why is this improvement valuable? Is something unclear, missing, or out of date?

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues/PRs for this improvement
- [ ] I am willing to submit a PR for this change
